name: curator_evals_bench
description: A community-curated collection of evaluation items intended to benchmark model outputs across a variety of tasks and modalities. It contains human-authored prompts, reference outputs, and/or rating instructions to support human and automated evaluation for model curation workflows. Designed for flexible use in assessing instruction-following, reasoning, and response quality.
reputation: Community-contributed dataset with limited but growing adoption for model curation and human-evaluation pipelines.
